Cardiorespiratory arrest ensued, requiring cardiopulmonary resuscitation with return of spontaneous circulation and respiration after 4 min. A gastric lavage was attempted, but quickly halted due to concerns of aspiration. Stabilization continued with atropine 0.02 mg/kg (0.2 mg) every 10–20 min for a total of 1 mg, due to ongoing signs of organophosphate poisoning including miosis, increased secretions and a brief self-terminating seizure.
